description:
## Scope
Implement Backends.ReqLLM, with subordinate option/stream/session modules as useful. Encapsulate generate_text, generate_object, embedding normalization, stream creation/consumption and usage reconciliation, ReqLLM.model/provider discovery, LLMDB normalization, provider schemas and generation key discovery.
Return original shared Response objects where possible. Adapt single/batch/return_usage embedding variants to Backend.Embedding. Wrap ReqLLM streams in Backend.Stream with native export preserving existing StreamResponse; final response includes available chunk/metadata usage and finish reason before handles are released.
Preserve keyword/map option behavior and safe existing-atom conversion; strip routing/internal execution keys before ReqLLM calls. Maintain HTTP/provider options and timeout translation. Keep backend model resolution compatible with legacy string acceptance and richer alias validation. ModelInfo/capabilities must permit unknown metadata rather than rejecting existing supported requests.
Provide opaque run-scoped session support for OpenAI/OpenAICodex WebSocket reuse and continuation translation, preparing extraction from ReActRunner. Resource ownership handles cancel, exceptions and owner death. Bind session reuse and continuation to effective model/deployment identity.

## Acceptance criteria
- Characterization tests pass against adapter calls.
- Response fields and underlying ReqLLM error behavior remain compatible.
- Portable and native stream views use the same underlying request without double consumption.
- Embeddings preserve ordering and known usage, with no fabricated metrics.
- Internal backend keys never reach ReqLLM generation options.
- Provider-specific session behavior is implemented within adapter boundaries.

## Suggested commit
feat(backend): implement default reqllm adapter
title: Implement default ReqLLM backend adapter
